ov: صراع في الميناء فيلم مصري من إنتاج عام 1956، من إخراج يوسف شاهين وبطولة فاتن حمامة، عمر الشريف، أحمد رمزي.
plotEn: The film takes place in a port in Alexandria and focuses on the lives of some sailors. Hamidah (Faten Hamama) works in a ship and plans to marry her cousin, Ragab (Omar Sharif), but Ragab is forced to leave for a long period. While he was away, Hamidah falls in love with Mamdouh, a wealthy man. Ragab returns three years later to find her in a relationship with someone else. He fights for her and wins her back again and marries her.
